name: Akili EndeavorOTC
short_description: FDA-cleared over-the-counter digital therapeutic video game for adults with ADHD that improves attention function without requiring a prescription.
long_description: EndeavorOTC is an FDA-cleared over-the-counter digital therapeutic for adults with ADHD, delivered through an engaging video game experience. Unlike the prescription EndeavorRx for children, EndeavorOTC is indicated for adults with primarily inattentive or combined-type ADHD and can be obtained without a prescription. The game uses the same neuroscience-based approach as EndeavorRx, employing sensory stimuli and motor challenges to target brain areas key to attention function. Users navigate courses, collect targets, and avoid obstacles while being challenged to multitask and ignore distractions. FDA cleared in June 2024, EndeavorOTC represents the first OTC digital therapeutic for adult ADHD.
one_liner: FDA-cleared OTC video game for adult ADHD
best_for: Adult psychiatrists and primary care providers whose adult ADHD patients may benefit from accessible
not_for: Patients with photosensitive epilepsy or conditions that preclude video game use
or those seeking pediatric ADHD treatment (use EndeavorRx)

faqs.q: What is the difference between EndeavorOTC and EndeavorRx?
faqs.a: EndeavorRx is a prescription product for children ages 8-17, while EndeavorOTC is an over-the-counter product for adults that doesn't require a prescription.

faqs.q: Do I need a prescription for EndeavorOTC?
faqs.a: No, EndeavorOTC is FDA-cleared as an over-the-counter product and can be obtained directly by adults with ADHD without a prescription.
EndeavorOTC received FDA clearance in June 2024 as the first OTC digital therapeutic for adult ADHD.
